The studio in Cloud Tower (JVT) is available from 18th August at AED 4,000/month all-inclusive. Here are the photos and full details: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-jumeirah-village-triangle-district-2-cloud-tower-cloud-tower-b-125644752.html

Worth knowing: there's no annual contract or Ejari, it runs on 3-month renewable blocks, so you're not locked in long-term. Would you like to arrange a viewing before committing?
